sermon.title: The Gift of the Holy Spirit
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that the gift of the Holy Spirit has the same requirements as salvation and is promised to all flesh in these last days. He walks through the Spirit’s expressions in Acts—wind, fire, tongues, boldness, signs, guidance into truth—and concludes that the most powerful proof is being changed into a good person and staying that way, with love as the more excellent way.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Joel’s prophecy dated “over 800 years” before Acts, later “a hundred years”; 15 languages at Pentecost; healed of valley fever (personal). Sensitive content kept as spoken: Muslims and “Jesus only” groups, “he was a liar” remark about Islam (19:00); water baptism required for remission; resurrected body “with no blood”; “that shows you don’t have the Holy Ghost” if you don’t read the Bible; “forget the poor… are we doing good in our home.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal. faqs.question: Is the Holy Spirit a gift?
faqs.answer: Yes—Acts 2:38 plainly calls it the gift of the Holy Ghost.

faqs.question: Is the gift of the Spirit for us today?
faqs.answer: Yes—to all who are far off, as many as the Lord shall call.

faqs.question: Do you automatically receive the Spirit at water baptism?
faqs.answer: No—you get it when you get it.

faqs.question: Can women prophesy?
faqs.answer: Yes—your sons and your daughters shall prophesy.

faqs.question: Is every dream from God?
faqs.answer: No—if there’s no message, it’s not a vision or dream from God.

faqs.question: Are tongues the only evidence of the Holy Spirit?
faqs.answer: He says the Bible doesn’t say that, though tongues are a proof.

faqs.question: Must you be an apostle for God to use you?
Can the change fade?
faqs.answer: Yes—you can grieve and quench the Spirit, so maintain it.

faqs.question: What do children want most from a dad?
faqs.answer: A good dad, not a prophet.

faqs.question: Where does doing good start?
faqs.answer: At home—control your tongue and behavior.
